name: Soya Chaap Roll
steps: Check the soya chaap pack is vegetarian. Remove the chaap from its sticks and follow any label instructions for pre-cooking; if packed in brine, rinse and simmer the pieces in water for 3 minutes, then drain and squeeze gently. Slice each cylindrical piece into 1–2 cm rounds so their layered soy texture remains visible. Pat dry.

Mix yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, Kashmiri chilli, coriander powder, turmeric, garam masala, 15 ml lemon juice and 4 g salt. Coat the chaap rounds and marinate for at least 20 minutes. Meanwhile knead the whole-wheat flour with 180 ml water, 5 ml oil and 3 g salt into a soft dough; cover and rest for 20 minutes.

Blend coriander leaves, mint leaves, green chilli, the remaining 15 ml lemon juice, 40 ml water and 1 g salt into a thick green chutney. Slice the red onion thinly and shred the lettuce. Keep the chutney thick so the wraps do not turn soggy.

Heat 20 ml oil in a wide pan over medium-high heat. Lay the marinated chaap slices in one layer, working in batches if necessary. Cook for 7–9 minutes, turning, until thoroughly hot and marked with golden-brown charred patches. Do not stir them into a loose mince; the rings should remain identifiable. Use the remaining 2 g salt only after tasting.

Divide dough into four balls. Roll each to a thin 22–24 cm round. Cook on a hot flat pan for about 1 minute per side, brushing the pan and rounds with the final 5 ml oil in total, until the parathas are cooked and show brown spots. Keep them covered and warm so they roll without cracking.

Spread one-quarter of the mint chutney on each warm paratha. Add one-quarter of the hot chaap rounds, onion and lettuce in a line across the middle. Fold the bottom up, tuck the sides and roll tightly. Slice one roll diagonally to show the soy-chaap filling, then serve all four immediately with any remaining chutney.
tips: The reviewed photo clearly shows ring-shaped layered soya chaap pieces inside flaky paratha wraps, with onion and green chutney. Use a prepared plain vegetarian soya chaap product, not paneer, tofu cubes or meat substitutes shaped like strips. Cook the filled chaap thoroughly according to its package directions.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
